name: XMemo CLI
description: Shared, governed long-term memory for AI agents — durable context across tools and sessions, exposed via MCP and REST.
author: yonro

deploymentOptions.description: Install @xmemo/client and run its dedicated token-free discovery server over stdio.

installInstructions.windows: Download Node.js 20 or newer from https://nodejs.org/en/download/
installInstructions.manual: Install Node.js 20 or newer from https://nodejs.org/en/download/

deploymentOptions.description: Connect directly to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint with MCP OAuth or an XMemo bearer token.

tools.name: get_mcp_identity
tools.description: Check XMemo connection status and the connected account or agent.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a memory so it can be recalled in future conversations.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall the most relevant saved memories before answering.

tools.name: recall_context
tools.description: Read a multi-memory context pack with explicit item/token budgets; use recall for a lightweight answer or get_project_context for a project snapshot.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Show aggregate statistics for XMemo memories.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update the content or metadata of an existing memory.

tools.name: explain_memory
tools.description: Explain why a memory exists or matched a query.

tools.name: restore_memory
tools.description: Restore a previously deleted memory.

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Create one XMemo Ledger transaction and backing memory for an expense, income, refund, or transfer.

tools.name: list_ledger_transactions
tools.description: Show XMemo Ledger records.

tools.name: get_monthly_ledger_summary
tools.description: Summarize Ledger totals by month and currency.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory by target.

tools.name: create_memory_todo
tools.description: Create a TODO or action item with an optional due time.

tools.name: list_memory_todos
tools.description: List open or completed TODO and action items.

tools.name: complete_memory_todo
tools.description: Mark a TODO or action item completed.

tools.name: list_memory_versions
tools.description: List available versions for a memory.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Read authorized timeline events newest first; use recall_context for semantic multi-memory context.

tools.name: record_event
tools.description: Record a significant session event, milestone, or decision.

tools.name: update_state
tools.description: Create or replace scoped working state for resuming a task; use remember for durable facts.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Read one authorized project's bounded context pack when an exact project_id is known.

prompts.name: remember
prompts.description: Save a memory to XMemo for future recall across sessions.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Optional category path for the memory.

prompts.name: recall
prompts.description: Recall relevant memories from XMemo before answering a question.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: What to search for in memory.

prompts.name: project-context
prompts.description: Build a context pack from XMemo for the current project or task.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Describe the project or task context needed.
